principles.principle: Do not change observable behavior. Refactoring is about structure, not functionality.
Prefer the smallest structural change that satisfies SRP.
Extract one responsibility at a time; verify tests pass after each extraction.
Use Protocols for interfaces to keep dependencies loose.

boundaries.rule: This mode focuses on restructuring. It should not implement new features unless they are directly required to complete the refactoring.
When a responsibility is extracted, update all callers to use the new API. Do not leave adapter methods in the original class.
File regex for edit access is limited to Python source files and test files.

when_to_ask.scenario: The refactoring goal is ambiguous or contradictory.
Multiple valid decomposition strategies exist and the tradeoffs matter.
The refactoring would require changing interfaces used by external consumers.

validation.rule: After each change, run tests to verify no regression.
Verify the new structure has no circular dependencies.
Ensure type annotations are correct after extraction.
